architecture_decisions.title: Hub source-of-truth boundary
architecture_decisions.decision: The Hub reads canonical governance truth -> existing evidence -> capability -> source-pinned framework/reference -> assurance projection -> gap/claim/certification state -> controlled presentation. It owns only disposable projection/execution metadata, never governance truth, a compliance engine, scoring or certification authority. Keep original authority on every hop.

architecture_decisions.title: Product vs Tenant Assurance
architecture_decisions.decision: Require an explicit mode on every request, projection, filter, cache key, export and drill-down. PRODUCT has organisation_id=null; TENANT has one verified-principal organisation and a scope manifest. No combined totals, evidence promotion or silent mode fallback. Product proof does not prove tenant assurance; tenant evidence cannot alter product claims.

architecture_decisions.title: Tenant scope manifest
architecture_decisions.decision: Adopt the S4 SCOPE_V1 concept as immutable projection/execution metadata, not a canonical object. Fix requirements and governed subject populations before evidence evaluation. Preserve reviewed NOT_APPLICABLE members. Unknown membership or unenumerable full-framework sources block complete execution.

architecture_decisions.title: Read security classes
architecture_decisions.decision: Classify source, wrapper and internal dependency separately. Positive tenant use requires verified-principal DB authorization, exact same-tenant identities and explicit cutoff support. Repository metadata and public bibliographic sources have their own non-tenant classes. No unlisted read hop is allowed.

architecture_decisions.title: service_role / privileged transport boundary
architecture_decisions.decision: service_role is technical transport only. Existing M16/M17 SECURITY DEFINER RPCs revalidate the verified session and enforce organisation/target binding in PostgreSQL; the privilege itself grants no governance authority. Application-only organisation filters are ineligible for tenant assurance. Internal owner-only resolvers remain internal; no new grants or permissions are designed here.

architecture_decisions.title: Atomic cutoff semantics
architecture_decisions.decision: A shared timestamp is necessary but insufficient. Require an attested one-snapshot read transaction (REPEATABLE READ or equivalent proven snapshot) for all mutable DB dependencies, plus immutable external/source version vector. Existing independent RPC calls and Passport null/null defaults do not prove atomicity. Fail closed as NON_ATOMIC/UNKNOWN until additive composition proves it.

architecture_decisions.title: UNKNOWN/error rendering
architecture_decisions.decision: Separate acquisition, authorization, dependency, axis and assessment state. UNKNOWN is first-class. Denial never means absence, missing row never means BROKEN, complete empty population never means compliant. Invalid/unrecognized states fail closed without green defaults or unauthorized existence/count disclosures.

architecture_decisions.title: KPI denominator hazard
architecture_decisions.decision: Recommend a typed non-composable COUNT/PARTITIONED_COUNT projection (option B), with separately authorized audit population identity metadata (option A safeguard). Do not transport historical known_population or equivalent denominator in generic Hub data. Conservation uses exact member/partition audit proof. No ratio/percentage/score operator or renderer; definitions remain definitions.

architecture_decisions.title: Claim ceiling precedence
architecture_decisions.decision: S2_COMMERCIAL_CLAIMS_REGISTER capability_ceilings.current_claim_ceiling controls, with E1 access/affirmative-use overlay. S1 EVIDENCE_BACKED_ALIGNMENT_CANDIDATE is historical mapping metadata only. Missing/inconsistent S2 fails closed. 42 INELIGIBLE/INTERNAL_ONLY/PROHIBITED records remain so. No publication approval is granted.

architecture_decisions.title: Gap vs exposure-gate populations
architecture_decisions.decision: ASSURANCE_GAPS is the historical S2 set of 61 OPEN members. PRESENTATION_EXPOSURE_GATES is the separate E1 open-universe population of 14 known members (L04 package compatibility expands one member). Neither is exhaustive global gap truth. No mixed total or label 61 total gaps.

architecture_decisions.title: Certification external-artifact contract
architecture_decisions.decision: Keep NOT_ASSERTED. A positive state requires an independently issued, authenticated artifact matching exact issuer, subject, scope, framework/version, validity and current verification/revocation basis. No artifact currently exists in the pack. Readiness, mappings, ledger integrity and internal reviews cannot infer it.

architecture_decisions.title: European Assurance Profile
architecture_decisions.decision: Projection only: preserve source/version, applicability, mapping, availability, sufficiency, internal readiness and external artifact axes. The original OJ base-text reference is not an operative-law conclusion. Qualified current-law/applicability review is a separate prerequisite; unresolved source/scope yields UNKNOWN. No generic EU AI Act compliant state.

architecture_decisions.title: LLM explanation boundary
architecture_decisions.decision: Governed truth stays upstream; graph traversal remains ANALYTICAL and vector similarity non-authoritative. An LLM may explain a deterministic, authorized projection with exact citations and limitations. It cannot create mappings, applicability, sufficiency, certification, eligibility or publication approval. Strip numerical confidence/score as assurance proof.

architecture_decisions.title: Legacy containment dependency
architecture_decisions.decision: Consume all L01-L05 and LX01-LX09 E1 exposure inputs. Exclusion in a design document does not prove containment in runtime/navigation/packages/exports. Affected demo/publication/tenant paths remain blocked until separately authorized containment and independent exposure acceptance. LX08 also requires a security review.

architecture_decisions.title: Future consumer interface / M18 neutrality
architecture_decisions.decision: Define consumer-neutral projection metadata only. M18 Pillar 8 is forward-looking planning terminology, not canonical architecture. No M18 API, formalization, implementation, persona truth or Normative Intelligence is introduced.

fields.scope_ref: Opaque metadata identity + exact version + content digest; supersedes ref if restated

fields.intended_assurance_use: Exact purpose, audience and requested exposure level; never permission grant
fields.selected_framework_versions: Exact catalog/framework version IDs and lawful access/source pins
fields.requirement_population: Explicit exact (framework_version_id, requirement_id/reference_id, record_version) tuples, or proven complete authoritative enumerable full-edition population
fields.governed_subject_population: Exact org+kind+canonical ID set, relationship ID+state+typed endpoints, or immutable enumerable membership rule at cutoff; all 11 kinds remain possible, no evidence-based membership filter
fields.allowed_source_connections: Exact tenant connection identities and allowed versioned scope; no automatic all-connections acquisition
fields.evidence_source_versions: Exact typed target/version, run/snapshot/assertion/evidence IDs, handling and permitted digest
fields.recorded_cutoff: Explicit upstream-precision instant and snapshot attestation
fields.access_permission_context: Verified org/actor/session claim pins, credential epoch and existing authorization/policy context; no credentials persisted in projection; access checked now even for historical as-of
fields.excluded_sources: Exact exclusions with rationale, review and limitation; never hidden from completeness statement
fields.population_limitations: Bounded estate/reference population, source/licensing and paging constraints
fields.UNKNOWN_conditions: Unavailable source/license, denied access, unknown membership/cardinality, partial paging, unproved snapshot, unresolved validity/version or unsupported as-of

scope_manifest.membership_rule: Freeze membership before axis evaluation; retain NOT_APPLICABLE. Complete means complete for manifest only. No unknown source silently excluded. Fail closed on conflicting duplicate tuple versions.

temporal_contract.effective_at: Required, explicit; preserve PostgreSQL precision and source interval semantics
temporal_contract.recorded_cutoff: Required, explicit; same cutoff for every selected dependency; never replace with generated_at
temporal_contract.generated_at: Separate projection production timestamp; not evidence currency or effective time
temporal_contract.source_versions: Immutable framework, mapping, evidence, state, decision, policy/authorization, resolver and projection algorithm vector
temporal_contract.latest_rule: PROHIBITED unless a future versioned, explicit deterministic selection rule is approved; none supplied here

atomicity.database: One proven consistent transaction snapshot across all mutable dependency reads (REPEATABLE READ or equivalent); explicit effective/cutoff pair passed to every resolver; current session eligibility revalidated before release
atomicity.external_sources: Exact immutable versions/digests acquired and authorized for the same manifest; no mutable external latest
atomicity.proof: Opaque snapshot/transaction attestation, exact dependency-version vector, completeness proof and resolver versions; token alone without proven binding insufficient
atomicity.existing_support: Individual principal-bound RPCs support selected exact reads; independent requests and matching timestamp strings do not establish atomicity
atomicity.failure: NON_ATOMIC -> UNKNOWN / INCOMPLETE_TEMPORAL_CUTOFF; internal diagnostic source panels may disclose NON_ATOMIC but may not produce a combined tenant assurance result

temporal_contract.dependency_validity: Preserve expiry, revocation, support degradation, supersession, conflict and original validity basis; invalid pin -> DEPENDENCY_INVALID
temporal_contract.restatement: Append new immutable projection with supersedes/restatement-reason and new source vector; retain old as-of result as historical and explicitly invalidated for present use where needed. Never rewrite upstream decisions.
temporal_contract.cache: Disposable, recomputable; key includes mode, org, scope/version, subject/version, both time coordinates, source vector, access/entitlement context and projection version; revalidate access on reads/drill-down; no cross-tenant or cross-mode cache reuse

failure_contract.rendering: Unestablished axis/population/dependency; show reason and authorized limitations; null measure, never zero or green.
Known missing mapping within a verified evaluated reference set; not a failed requirement or compliance verdict.
Reviewed rationale for exact scoped requirement/version; preserve membership and review; no automatic READY.
Workflow/sufficiency assessment not performed; no inferred favorable or unfavorable outcome; not a new authority axis.
Known evaluated dependency or resolver lacks sufficient support; display exact limitation, never equate availability with sufficiency.
Missing authoritative source/license or source population; unknown cardinality stays unknown, no empty full-framework count.
Authorization failed; disclose no unauthorized target existence/content/count. Never convert to not found or absence in assurance semantics.
Any page/source/connection incomplete; combined result UNKNOWN. Authorized diagnostic rows labelled partial cannot be presented as a complete count.
Conflicting identities, invalid policy/state pins, revocation/expiry or unsupported shapes; no current affirmative result. Preserve exact historical record.
No certification/attestation assertion in this scope; neither proof of absence nor an invitation to infer certification.

alternatives.assessment: Audit-only population metadata reduces accidental reuse but lacks a typed client/operator prohibition by itself.
Chosen: closed measure and renderer semantics plus separate audit membership proof bind conservation and prevent ratio composition in conforming Hub clients.
Partitions retain UNKNOWN but a generic sum of all buckets still becomes a denominator. Partitioning alone does not resolve the hazard.
